source.other:
Directly view PDF documents in your Nextcloud.
As an added bonus, this app can also display Adobe Illustrator (.ai) files.
Powered by [pdf.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/)

target.other:
Visa PDF-dokument direkt i din Nextcloud.

Drivs av [pdf.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/)
